successful_sampled_cluster_definition: high-support post-resurgence edge with at least 5 attributed tips and an assigned-tip minimum possible sampling span of at least 180 days
interval_compatible_sampled_cluster_defi: high-support post-resurgence edge with at least 5 attributed tips and an assigned-tip maximum possible sampling span of at least 180 days
sample_span_days_semantics: Backwards-compatible alias of assigned_span_max_days; both assigned span bounds use only event-attributed tips
uncertainty_semantics: PastML marginal-state support propagated through a modular phylogeographic layer; not a full joint phylogenetic posterior
